note: Samsara tag -> Traumasoft cost center, for tags a name match cannot reach.
build_vehicle_cost_centers.py already matches a tag to a cost center by
exact name, and by name ignoring the legal-entity wrapper, so
'Parma Heights' finds 'Lynx EMS LLC dba Lynx Parma Heights' on its own.
This file is only for tags that say the same thing in different words --
a radio designator, a station code, an old name.
DELIBERATELY NO SUBSTRING MATCHING. A tag is a short label, and
substring-matching short labels is how 'Columbus' claims Columbus Ohio
and Columbus Indiana at once. An entry here is a decision; a substring
Run probe_samsara_tags.py first. Its section 2 prints the real tag
vocabulary and section 6 shows which tags already look like cost center
names -- everything left over belongs here.
Copy to state/tag_cost_center_map.json to put it in effect.
